content:
Update `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` to add prod-only inline patches.

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../clusters/
  - ../../infra/

patches:
  # 1) App replicas: 2 -> 4
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 4

  # 2) RDS instance class: db.t3.micro -> db.t3.medium
  # 3) Enable multi-AZ for RDS
  - target:
      group: rds.aws.crossplane.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: DBInstance
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/dbInstanceClass
        value: db.t3.medium
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/multiAZ
        value: true

  # 4) S3 cross-region replication to us-west-2
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.crossplane.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/replicationConfiguration
        value:
          role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role
          rules:
            - status: Enabled
              destination:
                bucket: arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-replica-us-west-2
                storageClass: STANDARD
              filter:
                prefix: ""
```

Notes:
- This changes only `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`, so dev remains untouched.
- If your base has multiple `Deployment`, `DBInstance`, or `Bucket` objects, add `name:` under each `target` to scope the patch to the exact prod resource.
- The S3 replication patch assumes Crossplane-style S3 resources and requires a real replication IAM role ARN and destination bucket ARN.
